uuid.description: Stable public identifier; survives file replacement

name.description: Editable label; the uploaded file name by default

url.description: Delivery URL (/cms-api/v1/assets/<uuid>). The only way to fetch asset bytes; 403 when the asset has groups and the caller is in none of them.

mime_type.description: MIME type recorded at upload: the canonical type of the extension (a CSV is text/csv)

extension.description: The checked file extension, lower case, no dot ("png"). The stored file has none; this is what gives the right type and download name. null for assets uploaded before extensions were stored.

file_name.description: The download name: <name>-<uuid>.<extension> (the name with other characters than letters, digits, space, dot, underscore and hyphen replaced by an underscore, cut to 100 characters), or <uuid>.<extension> for an asset without a name. The delivery URL sends it in Content-Disposition.

alt.description: Default alt text; a section's own alt field overrides it

roles.description: Roles that may manage the asset in the CMS (role_data_access, resource type asset). The admin role is never listed: it manages every asset without a grant.

groups.description: Groups that may view the asset; empty = public

can_view.description: Whether the CALLER may open the file on the website/app: true for a public asset, an admin, or a member of one of the asset's groups. When false the delivery URL answers 403, so a client shows a lock instead of a preview.

can_update.description: Whether the CALLER may edit this asset in the CMS: the UPDATE bit of a role_data_access grant on this asset (the admin role always). When false an edit answers 403.

can_delete.description: Whether the CALLER may delete this asset in the CMS: the DELETE bit of a role_data_access grant on this asset (the admin role always). When false a delete answers 403.

duplicates.description: Only in an upload response: other assets with exactly the same bytes that the CALLER may manage (at most 5). Nothing is refused; the editor is only told. Never cached.
